investigate: Students with learning disabilities may have difficulty understanding ==abstract scientific concepts and terminology== and relating them to everyday life.
The study explores ==teachers’ and students’ views== on the Grade 4 Food unit, using an embedded single-case design.
Data came from semi-structured interviews with ==10 teachers and 10 students== and document analysis.
find: Students learned about foods within the ==food groups they encountered== in everyday life.
They showed ==conceptual deficiencies in relating nutrients== to everyday foods and struggled with science terminology.
Despite teachers’ reported use of everyday examples, ==students still struggled to link them== to scientific concepts.
Teachers’ use of ==instructional adaptations showed deficiencies==.

caption.question: How do students with learning disabilities make sense of science terminology about food?
caption.intro: Tuğba Pürsün and Gizem Türkoğlu Boyvat explore **teacher and student views** on the Grade 4 Food unit, highlighting the relationship among conceptual difficulties, everyday life connections and teachers’ reported instructional practices.
